study: All remaining 36 official training sequences in the preregistered third external cohort. Never used to fit the PINNS checkpoints. 54 windows from 29 sequence-local people; descriptive.
inputs: Official camera-time offline tracked 2D crops and metric 3D centres. A single t0 virtual-LiDAR coordinate frame via each per-frame calibration. No gesture ground truth; 17-image keypoints estimated by RTMPose. No adaptation.
primary: Four fixed PINNS checkpoint errors equally weighted first, then pooled across 54 windows and 29 sequence-local identities. Intersection and sequence summaries include zero-support groups. No inference to additional people/sites. Primary zero-degree M1 minus M0 ADE. All rotations prespecified, no selection. Network uses fixed 0.1s discretization; measured clock separately reported for every case.
statistical_scope: Descriptor of this fixed source release and enrolled people. 29 IDs local to 10 sequences in 4 supported intersections; the identifiers do not repeat between the enrolled sequences. Per-window and equal-person estimands have different directions. Four source folds per window are frozen model replicas. No population confidence interval.
